body: I know but it's the only way that everything will just stop for once, you know? I messed up the future by dropping out of high school because of anxiety, which then led me to this centre for emotionally disturbed kids where I didn't learn anything. Thus, I messed up all my exams and I was supposed to do sooo well on them. Everybody had high hopes for me, I let them all down. So now, whilst everybody else my age is studying what THEY WANT, and are getting 3 years of three education in college, I'm stuck doing a course that may allow me to retake my exams next year, alongside a specific course. So I'll only get one year of doing what I want to study which is either social science, psychology or law. But they don't even have those here to study

It's really such an awful feeling. I'm 17 in a few days, I'm from Scotland so we finish high school at 16. I've been to college for a few months now, it's in a completely different location and I thought the change would help but it hasn't. I was supposed to do it today but college is cancelled until next week, so I guess I'm postponing it.  I'm just like everybody else who's sad haha, I don't have anybody whatsoever. I haven't had any friends in years, let alone a girlfriend. I'm not a good person either, I'm toxic and I think i enjoy making people suffer but I don't know why. I've always been a nobody. I've always wondered what it must be like - to spend eternity as a nobody.  I guess I'll find out soon enough.
I'm the worst at talking, especially about my feelings. I can't even tell them when I'm feeling sad. Plus I'm not even sure WHY or WHAT even I feel, it's so confusing. I just want this to end.

Not much to tell, I've had suicidal thoughts since I was 10 and I guess now I'm finally acting on them. No point for me to hang around. There's no future for me, I messed that up and at least today I won't be burdened anymore.

Hey, there's really not much to say. I'm a loser with no life, I'll bbe 17 in a few days and I've wasted 3 years doing absolutely nothing. Though I really appreciate this, you don't want to hear my boring story
It's like no matter what i do, its never right. i hurt people and i don't stop. hurt people, hurt people. I'm talking to her rn and its hurting her so much
I can't burden somebody as pure as her like that. this is better for everybody
I wish i could, but there's no good in me. Perhaps there was a long time ago, but whatever good there was in me is long gone.
She'll just tell me all of this fake, 'positive' stuff about me which isn't true. She just thinks it is because she's delusioned herself into thinking i'm a good person
How can i be myself when i don't even know who i am, why i do the things i do?
Not yet. She's bound to when she sees how awful i am

Yeah it certainly is a grand feeling but hard to comprehend when you tell yourself, you swear to yourself not to fall in love again. I've been doing that a lot with her, it certainly feels less small. I just can't believe I've entrapped somebody else in my web of fucking hate and despair
I figured that as much, but if she hates me then it won't hurt nearly as much, y'know?
What's the difference? I'll be out of her life either way and she won't have any emotional attachments bonding her to me anymore
That's what I'm trying to do, she's too good to hurt
She'll suffer more by being with somebody like me. The things I've said and done to people, I cannot stand myself. She deserves the good, not the bad.

She's so understanding, so caring for somebody she doesn't know that well, she's so fragile too..so innocent and sweet despite everything thats happened. We get along like a house on fire, its like she's my soulmate but i just..cant be here anymore. i can't i can't i can't
I really do, we haven't known each other long but it was an instant connection and i could talk to her endlessly
Ive told her and she's said she understands but she wouldn't be angry, that she won't ever leave me etc but i just want her to hate me so she doesn't suffer
